@charset "utf-8"; :root { --primary: #f472b6; --primary-dark: #db2777; --primary-light: #fbcfe8; --secondary: #a855f7; --bg-dark: #1a0b1a; --text-dark: #4a1d4a; --text-title: #701a75; --danger: #f43f5e; --success: #10b981; --bg-glass: rgba(255, 245, 250, 0.95); } body { margin: 0px; padding: 0px; font-family: Tahoma, Verdana, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; background-color: var(--bg-dark); background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-attachment: fixed; background-size: cover; display: block; height: 100vh; color: var(--text-dark); transition: background-image 1.5s ease-in-out 0s; overflow: hidden; } .home-logo-link { position: fixed; top: 20px; right: 415px; z-index: 100; } .home-logo { width: 60px; height: 60px; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--primary-light); box-shadow: rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.4) 0px 5px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.3s ease 0s, box-shadow 0.3s ease 0s; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); object-fit: cover; } .home-logo:hover { transform: scale(1.1); box-shadow: rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.6) 0px 8px 25px; } #shooting-stars { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; } #start-overlay { position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(30, 10, 30, 0.85); display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; z-index: 9999; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); transition: opacity 0.5s ease 0s; } .start-btn { padding: 18px 45px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary)); color: white; border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); border-radius: 50px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.6) 0px 0px 25px; transition: all 0.3s ease 0s; text-transform: uppercase; } .player-container { position: fixed; top: 20px; right: 20px; width: 380px; background: var(--bg-glass); border: 1px solid var(--primary-light); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 20px 50px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; z-index: 100; } .player-header { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--secondary), var(--primary)); color: white; padding: 10px 15px; font-weight: bold; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .player-header h1 { font-size: 12px; margin: 0px; font-weight: bold; } .status-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; background-color: var(--danger); border-radius: 50%; transition: background 0.3s ease 0s; } .status-dot.ready { background-color: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--success); } .visual-display { background: rgb(0, 0, 0); height: 220px; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } #visualizer { position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; } .disk-spin { width: 130px; height: 130px; background: url("https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/1384/1384060.png") center center / contain no-repeat; border-radius: 50%; animation: 5s linear 0s infinite normal none paused spin; border: 4px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); display: none; z-index: 1; } #yt-player-wrapper { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: none; } #yt-player-wrapper iframe { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; } .song-info { padding: 12px; background: rgb(253, 242, 248); text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--primary-light); } .song-title { font-weight: bold; color: var(--text-title); font-size: 13px; margin: 0px; } .controls { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px; background: rgb(255, 251, 255); } button.ctrl-btn { background: white; border: 1px solid var(--primary-light); border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--primary-dark); } button.ctrl-btn.active { background: var(--primary); color: white; border-color: var(--primary); } .playlist-box { flex-grow: 1; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); overflow-y: auto; max-height: 140px; } .playlist { list-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; } .playlist li { padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgb(252, 231, 243); cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .playlist li.active { background: rgb(253, 242, 248); color: rgb(190, 24, 93); font-weight: bold; border-left: 4px solid var(--primary); } .add-music-area { padding: 8px; background: rgb(255, 251, 255); display: flex; gap: 5px; flex-wrap: wrap; border-top: 1px solid rgb(252, 231, 243); } .add-music-area input { flex: 1 1 0%; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-light); border-radius: 4px; outline: none; } .timer-area { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 5px; color: rgb(157, 23, 77); } .timer-area select { font-size: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-light); border-radius: 3px; color: rgb(157, 23, 77); } .tag-yt { background: var(--primary-dark); color: white; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 9px; } .tag-mp3 { background: var(--secondary); color: white; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 9px; } @keyframes spin { 100% { transform: rotate(360deg); } } .wish-container { position: fixed; top: 20px; left: 20px; width: 300px; max-height: 80vh; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); border: 1px solid var(--primary-light); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) 0px 10px 30px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); z-index: 100; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; } .wish-header { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), #c084fc); color: white; padding: 10px; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; } .wish-header h2 { font-size: 12px; margin: 0px; font-weight: bold; display: inline; } .wish-input-group { padding: 10px; display: flex; gap: 5px; background: rgb(255, 241, 242); } .wish-input-group input { flex: 1 1 0%; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--primary-light); border-radius: 5px; outline: none; } .wish-input-group button { background: var(--primary); color: white; border: none; padding: 0px 15px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; } .wish-wall { padding: 10px; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; } .wish-item { background: white; padding: 8px 12px; border-left: 4px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 2px 5px; animation: 0.3s ease 0s 1 normal none running slideIn; color: var(--text-title); } @keyframes slideIn { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-20px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0px); } } @media (max-width: 768px) { .wish-container { width: 200px; font-size: 11px; } .home-logo-link { right: auto; left: 230px; } } @media (max-width: 450px) { .player-container { top: 10px; right: 10px; width: calc(100% - 20px); } .home-logo-link { inset: auto 20px 20px auto; } .home-logo { width: 50px; height: 50px; } }
